remediatedFindings.resolution: Added a service-only durable claim operation that distinguishes new, successful duplicate, retryable failure, and in-progress deliveries.
Added a database-owned payment receipt state machine that preserves partial and full refund state under late payment events.
Checkout and invoice operations now derive amount, currency, state, ownership, and entitlement targets from server-owned records.
Invoice creation, dunning, and manual settlement now execute in transactional database functions and propagate persistence errors.
Public clients supply validated request UUIDs; server routes hash them, and shared IP/day checkout keys were removed.
Service and care checkout completion now records a unique durable fulfillment before best-effort downstream capture.
Academy membership and Discord premium persistence now fail closed, and Discord role assignment requires configured roles.
Cancellation validates the subscription identifier and verifies local user ownership before any Stripe mutation.
Paid enrollment now requires both an explicit enablement flag and the canonical certified state; current Academy commerce remains closed.
Stable idempotency keys cover customer, product, and subscription creation, and an existing active engagement blocks duplicate creation.
